verses.en: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
verses.sm: Tavita fale mona i le aai o Tavita, ma ua saunia le mea mo le atolaau a le Atua, ua faia foi le fale ie mo le atolaau.

verses.en: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the LORD chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.
verses.sm: Ona fai atu ai lea o Tavita, E le tatau ona ave e nisi le atolaau a le Atua ua na o sa Levi; aua ua filifilia i latou e le ALI e ave le atolaau a le Atua, ma auauna ia te ia e faavavau.

verses.en: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the LORD unto his place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.sm: Ona faapotopotoina lea e Tavita o Isaraelu uma i Ierusalema, e avae le atolaau a le ALti i le mea ua saunia e ia e tuu ai.

verses.en: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:
verses.sm: Ua faapotopotoina foi e Tavita o le fanauga a Arona, ma sa Levi;

verses.en: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:
verses.sm: o le fanauga a Koato; o Urielu le alii sili, atoa ma ona uso e toaselau ma le toaluafulu.

verses.en: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Merari; o Asaia le alii sili, atoa ma ona uso e toalua selau ma le toaluafulu.

verses.en: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Keresona; o Ioelu le alii sili, atoa ma ona uso e toaselau ma le toatolugafulu.

verses.en: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Elisafano; o Semaia le alii sili, atoa ma ona uso e toalua selau.

verses.en: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:
verses.sm: O le fanauga a Heperona; o Elielu le alii sili, atoa ma ona uso E toavalu sefulu.

verses.en: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.
verses.sm: to O le fanauga a Usialu; o Aminatapu le alii sili, atoa ma ona uso e toaselau ma le toasefulu ma le toalua.

verses.en: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.sm: Ua aami atu e Tavita o Satoka, ma Aviata O faitaulaga, ma sa Levi, ma Urielu, ma Asaia, ma loelu, ma Semaja, ma Elielu, ma Aminatapu,

verses.en: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.
verses.sm: ua faapea atu ia te i latou, O outou o matai sili o sa Levi; la faapaiaina outou ia te outou, atoa ma o outou uso, e au mai ai e outou le atolaau a le ALU, o le Atua o Isaraelu, i le mea ua saunia e au e tuu ai.

verses.en: For because ye did it not at the first, the LORD our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
verses.sm: Aua na osofia i tatou e le ALII lo tatou Atua, ina ua le muai aumaia e outou; aua na tatou le sailiili ia te ia e tusa ma le tulafono.

verses.en: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the LORD God of Israel.
verses.sm: Ona faapaiaina lea o faitaulaga, ma sa Levi ia te i latou e avae ai le atolaau a le ALI le Atua o Isaraelu.

verses.en: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.
verses.sm: Ua amo e le fanauga a sa Levi le atolaau a le Atna i ona amo i o latou ua, e pei ona poloai mai 0 Mose e tusa ma le afioga a le Aw.

verses.en: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.
verses.sm: Ua fai atu Tavita i alii sili o sa Levi, ia latou tofi ni o latou uso e usua pese i laaupese, o napeli, ma kitara, ma sumepalo, e pepese ai ma le leo tele e fiafia ai.

verses.en: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.sm: Ua tofia e sa Levi o Hemana le atalii o Ioelu, i le ma Asafo le atalii o Perekia ai ona uso; na tofia foi ai le fanauga a Merari o latou uso, o Etano le atalii o Kusaia.

verses.en: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the porters.
verses.sm: O latou uso foi e aupito ane ia te i latou, o Sakaria, o Pene, ma laasielu, ma Semira608 I. NOFOAIGA mota, ma Ikielu, ma Uni, o Eliapo, ma Penaia, ma Maaseia, ma Matitia, ma Elipeleu, ma Mikenau, ma Opete-etoma, ma Ieielu, o le au leoleo faitotoa.

verses.en: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
verses.sm: O le au usu pese lenei; o Hemana, o Asafo, ma Etano, na tofia i latou ma sumepalo ‘apa memea e faatagitagi ai.

verses.en: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;
verses.sm: O Sakaria foi, ma Asielu, ma Semiramota,ma Ikielu,ma Uni,ma Eliapo, ma Maaseia, ma Penaia, na tofia i latou ma napeli i alemota;

verses.en: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.
verses.sm: 0 Matitia, ma Elipeleu, ma Mikenau, ma Opete-etoma, ma leielu, ma Asesau, Na i ai kitara i seminita, e ta‘ita‘i ai le pese.

verses.en: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.
verses.sm: O Kinania foi le alii sili o sa Levi, o le usu pese ia, ua na a'oa'o i pese, aua ua poto ia.

verses.en: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.sm: O Perekia foi, ma Elekana, o leoleo faitotoa i laua mo le atolaau.

verses.en: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.sm: O Sepania, ma losefatu, ma Natanielu, ma Amesai, ma Sakaria, ma Penaia, ma Elisara, le au faitaulaga, e a latou e faasasau i pu i luma o le atolaau a le Atua. O Opete-etoma, ma Ikia, o leoleo faitotoa i laua mo le atolaau.

verses.en: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.
verses.sm: Ua o atu Tavita, ma toeaina o Isaraelu, ma alii o taitoaafe, e au mai le atolaau o le feagaiga a le ALII ma le fiafia nai le fale o Opete-etoma.

verses.en: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the LORD, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.sm: Na fesoasoani le Atua i sa Levi e na ave le atolaau o le feagaiga a le ALII; ona latou osia lea o le taulaga, o povi poa e fitu, ma mamoe poa e fitu.

verses.en: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.
verses.sm: Ua ofu Tavita i le ofu ie vavae, o sa Levi uma foi o e na ave le atolaau, ma È pepese, ma Kinania o le usu pese sili i E pepese. Sa ofu Tavita i le efota ie vavae.

verses.en: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the LORD with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.
verses.sm: Ua avae e A TUPU 15,16 Isaraelu uma le atolaau o le feagaiga a le ALII ma le alalaga, ma le leo o le foafoa, ma pu, ma sumepalo, ua ta foi napeli, ma kitara.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the LORD came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
verses.sm: Ua oo le atolaau o le feagaiga a le ALII i le aai a Tavita, ona vaai ifo lea o Mekala le afafine o Saulo i le faamalama, ua iloa atu le tupu o Tavita o saa ma siva, ona ‘ino‘ino lea o ia ia te ia i lona loto.
